links.outcome: Prospective performance of segmentation model in live clinical workflow versus retrospective validation
links.effect: Automated segmentation sufficient in 2/10 patients; 8/10 needed corrections (median 11 min). Median Dice kidney 1.00 (0.58-1.00), tumor 0.98 (0.00-1.00).
links.quote: In 2/10 patients the automated segmentation was sufficient to be used directly.

links.outcome: Whether clinician review and correction catches errors in AI segmentations
links.effect: 8/10 automated segmentations required correction, median correction time 11 min; errors included tumor border under-segmentation (n=3) and tumor/kidney border misidentification (n=3).
links.quote: In 8/10 patients the automated segmentation needed corrections (with a median correction time of 11 min).

screen.reason: Prospective clinical workflow integration evaluating automated MRI segmentation with human-in-the-loop clinician review and manual correction for 3D surgical planning models.
